auth: the setup link's secret, in the header X-Share-Setup
notes: Only while the storage folder on a drive isn't set up yet: share serve then serves just this page's API, /healthz and the website's /setup, and logs <public_url>/setup#SECRET, with a secret made at this start. The page sends it in X-Share-Setup; a missing or older one is 403 forbidden, and every other API call 503 setting_up. exists and empty say what the folder holds; an empty folder may be a drive that isn't mounted. fs_type, total_bytes and free_bytes are the drive's, or those of the nearest folder above when the folder doesn't exist yet. warnings are share check's findings about that drive ({code, level, message}, codes from contract/storage_warnings.json). After the setup, the server answers as in setup_ready.json.
